rapport_notes: Jules is friendly, professional, and patient with a talkative customer; handles the customer's expertise and concerns with respect and ease.
process_discipline_notes: After the agenda question ('what are your biggest concerns'), the customer said 'nothing. This is a very straightforward move,' but Jules did not pause or follow up with genuine two-layer probing—she pivoted immediately to collecting contact info and logistics.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Sure thing I can certainly help you get a quote right now... I'm gonna start with a few questions to, you know, get us under right track and that would take about like six minutes and then I'll be able to get you an accurate quote after that.
evidence_quotes.agenda: General what are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer: 'Well, nothing. This is a very straightforward, very easy move.' Jules: 'Awesome. Sounds good. Great, that is what we'd, like, may, can you give me your email address please...' [No follow-up or two-layer exploration.]
evidence_quotes.careful_with: Do you think you have anything that would wait over £300 on its own? [Implicit carefulness framing, though not the exact 'what do you need us to be most careful with' line. Customer response confirms high-value items requiring care: 'these things I'm moving...the things that we have here are very expensive, so that, that's why Karen [care/attention] has to be made in their, in their movement.']
evidence_quotes.communication: The guys will give you a call on Monday to let you know once they're on their way. [Covers day-before/prior notification, not full Communication differentiator (no named crew lead, no inbox updates).]
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: We have a minimum of two and a half hours... the rate is $204 and that includes everything. So the minimum of two and a half hours is $510. [Gives a specific minimum and rate, but does not anchor to a typical range or personalize it to floor/walk/boxes/drive factors, even though many were discussed.]
evidence_quotes.self_prep_tip: We will also bring our own tools for any disassemble or reassembly for the furniture. It's all included.
evidence_quotes.close: Well, we do have availability right now for either Monday or Tuesday. We can start in the morning around 8:30 tonight if you'd like to get on schedule. [Implicit offer to book, but no explicit rate-lock statement and no direct close like 'would you like our help with your move?']

top_strength: Jules nailed the quid pro quo upfront ('six minutes, then an accurate quote') and asked the agenda question before diving into logistics, setting a solid discovery foundation.
coaching_note: When the customer said 'nothing' to concerns, Jules missed a critical two-layer opportunity—a pause and a genuine follow-up ('what about care for those expensive pieces, or timeline pressure, or anything else on your list?') would have surfaced real differentiator hooks and earned the ramp-up pitch; instead she pivoted to form-filling and left Stage 2 limp.
